title: Binance Adds OG/TRY & PEPE/TRY Trading Pairs
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will open trading for the OG/TRY and PEPE/TRY trading pairs at  2023-05-10 08:00 (UTC) .   Start Trading on Binance Spot Now! Notes:  The “Market Order - Total” and “Slider for Amount Customization” features will not be available for the PEPE/TRY trading pair. Users can still choose to input “Market Order - Amount” manually to place market orders on the PEPE/TRY trading pair. For more information, please refer to this  announcement . TRY is a fiat currency and does not represent any other digital currencies. Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail. Thanks for your support! Binance Team 2023-05-09 Trade on-the-go with Binance’s crypto trading app (iOS/Android) Find us on  Telegram Twitter Facebook Instagram Note: This announcement was last updated on 2023-05-09 to clarify that users will not be able to access the “Market Order - Total” and “Slider for Amount Customization” features when placing market orders for the PEPE/TRY trading pair. Binance reserves the right in its sole discretion to amend or cancel this announcement at any time and for any reasons without prior notice.
